scope: Read-only exact source audit/specification. No edits, builds or tests. Engine availability implementation remains separate.
decision: Allow a structurally valid referenced source project/track whose stored engine is unavailable when the destination sounding engine is available. A reference supplies a pattern, not a sound adoption transaction. Do not apply full project engine availability guards to pattern-only preflight/decode.

actual_dataflow.referenced_source: Preparation copies steps, four timing values LEN/DIV/SWING/GATE and whole motion store into immutable chain source; stored engine ID is retained only as per-track motion provenance. Project engine parameters, presets, sound envelopes, FM6 patch bytes, global settings and instruments are not adopted.
actual_dataflow.sounding_destination: seq_step looks up destination ENGINES[t->eng_req], mapping keys, scale, transpose behavior and note rendering. Existing destination mix/sound/FM6 patches/voice ownership remain underneath scene overrides.
actual_dataflow.common_motion: Eligible IDs below P_FM1_ATK use source owner/place but destination param_desc and param_fit. They apply across engine differences. This includes supported envelopes, common sound controls, FX sends, pan, glide and detune admitted by motion_param.
actual_dataflow.engine_specific_motion: IDs >=P_FM1_ATK require exact stored source_engine == destination eng_req: FM envelope/levels61..80, DRUM lane levels83..90, engine E0..E791..98. The same predicate is used both for applying automation/locks and resolving automation when locks unlock. Destination motion_base and locked bitsets are independently indexed per destination.
actual_dataflow.assets: Source preset/patch/sample data is not adopted. Notes and compatible locks can exercise destination-owned engine/sample resources, including SET/KIT edits; engine component and sample availability remain destination capability obligations. A missing source asset is not itself a pattern-reference refusal. Structural/source CRC/reference integrity remains required.

historical_normalization: Native schema decoder pins parts8/phys2 but does not normalize DIGITAL/PERC on pattern preparation. Raw source engine provenance is intentionally compared exactly; do not map DIGITAL provenance to FM6 and then replay historical FM4 parameter semantics unchanged.

Offline historical import does run actual PHYS/drum, DIGITAL conversion and PERC normalization and removes incompatible motion records before encoding canonical native sources. Its resulting source IDs/motion are the canonical provenance.

Direct native records with DIGITAL or parameter-based PERC aliases can still supply generic patterns/common motion; mismatched destination engines skip source-specific records. No sound substitution occurs. A future normalized-provenance optimization would need the actual motion migration, not just ID rewriting.
necessary_refusal_points: Retain structural/source CRC, foreign/future/ambiguous pool metadata, bounds, references, stopped/backend/arena ownership, input/storage generation and final inventory/metadata checks. Missing referenced object still refuses; object3 never aliases autosave.

If a reduced compiled profile is eventually enabled, check destination actual selectable engine availability for every destination at preparation before old-cache invalidation, then defensively recheck under final publication guard. Do not require source engine presence in that mask. Supported public sound setters/adoption must enforce destination availability separately.
Unsupported engine-specific source motion is skipped by existing compatibility predicate, not substituted or reinterpreted. Unsupported destination sound must refuse without selecting another engine.

Do not make shared structural d8pr_preflight reject all unavailable stored engines: catalogs and pattern preparation must remain usable without sound adoption. Full engine guards belong to d8p1_load_runtime/project restore/sound load, not copied pattern-source validation.
cache_semantics: Failures before policy invalidation preserve existing prepared/suspended cache. Once copying starts, preparation marks native policy invalid/preparing and disarms old route; late failure may discard prior suspended preparation but cannot publish partial sources. Live editable music remains unchanged.
Final publication verifies source inventory metadata, retained arrangement CRC, store epoch, preparation state and held-input generation; no transaction-wide concurrent-writer protection is claimed.

Fresh Start/Continue during copying cancels preparation. Successful sound/project adoption and source mutation retain existing invalidation behavior; pattern-only availability policy should not weaken it.
implementation_tests: Use actual native pool fixture with unavailable source engine and available destination: SONG prepare/start succeeds, source notes/timing/common pan/FX automation and locks apply, exact destination engine/parameters outside motion/FM6 patch/cache identity/undo/project/raw source bytes remain intact.

Add incompatible source E0, lane and FM-envelope automation+locks; assert skipped values and unlock restore destination base. Repeat for two destinations aliasing one source with distinct base values, and same-engine compatible control.

Use raw DIGITAL source with FM6 destination in FM4-off build; common motion applies, historical FM-specific records remain skipped. Canonically migrated DIGITAL/PERC/PHYS fixtures assert actual removed motion and resulting provenance instead of simple alias substitution.

An unavailable engine on an unused source track or unreferenced structurally valid project must not block referenced pattern playback. Missing object, invalid IDs/CRC/reference/foreign format remain refusals.

Test unavailable destination engine initial refusal preserves old cache and zero LCD/live/patch/undo mutation; inject late destination invalidation during actual LCD/backend read and assert conservative invalid cache with unchanged live music and no armed/transport start.

Use real compile-time immutable profile seams only as test arguments until gates open; do not remove backend write quarantine or build-profile refusal. Preserve existing late activity/store-change/start, scene overlay and held-owner tests.
qualification: Existing source test covers common alias pan/lock/unlock and changed destination engine filtering of FM envelope. It does not yet prove unavailable source masks or all suggested cases. Source inspection is not executed-check or physical timing evidence.
